The on-site dates have just changed, so check before you book.

- A Slack reminder in #compliance dated Nov 17 still says the PCI auditors are on site **Dec 8–10 in Austin**, and asks the TLV folks flying in to book flights by end of week [2].
- But a Gmail thread dated Nov 16 says Ardent (QSA Victor Lindqvist) moved the fieldwork: the second assessor had a conflict the week of Dec 7, so it's now **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17**, same format, at the Austin office, and Shira replied that Dec 15–17 works and asked for updated invites [3]. The earlier invite had it at Dec 8–10 [4].
- The evidence package deadline is unchanged at Dec 1 in the Ardent portal [3][1].

So the two sources conflict; the Slack reminder looks out of date relative to the email. I'd confirm with Avi or Shira before booking — Dec 15–17 is the arrangement agreed with the assessor [3][2].

Note: the Austin holiday party is Friday Dec 11 at the office rooftop [5].
